metadata.featurePolicy: Wednesday 18:00 UTC snapshot; earlier games only; 730-day feature window; 8-appearance half-life; 200-play zero-EPA prior.
metadata.qbPolicy: Last eligible game dominant passer; not the actual target-game starter. No historical injury-feed reconstruction.
metadata.availabilityPolicy: completed_at conservatively means kickoff + 24h, not a recorded final whistle.
metadata.marketPolicy: nflverse archived spread and side odds; snapshot time/book not supplied. Benchmark returns, not verified executable bets.
metadata.vintagePolicy: Historical EPA is from the current downloaded nflfastR release, not contemporaneous archived model snapshots. Future game outcomes are excluded from feature aggregation, but source model-vintage/revision effects remain.
metadata.attribution: Derived from nflverse and nflfastR play-by-play (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), filtered and aggregated by Dirt IQ. No endorsement implied. Schedule source: nflverse/nfldata.
metadata.evaluationPolicy: 2023–2024 development comparison; 2025 reserved for an explicit final check. No claim of a betting edge.
